items.title: Backpack Launches First 24/7 Market for Real U.S. Equities
items.summary: Backpack, a crypto-traditional finance bridge platform, launched 24/7 trading for select U.S. equities including SpaceX, Micron, and SanDisk for international investors. Unlike synthetic derivatives, investors hold real securities with instant settlement and continuous price discovery, available via fiat or stablecoins.
